name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.ShallowSplit.class_flip_bound
title: A class whose members always share labels has at most as many members as one flip step touches
statement: Labels l : Nat -> V -> U -> Bool with l 0 = false and l n = true everywhere; label changes at step t and suffix u lie in F t u with |F t u| <= f; if all members of c have equal labels in every hybrid then |c| <= f.
